purpose: Teach: あめ/サヨナラ/ミーハー/ひとみ/られよ/スキップ/バツ/下敷き

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、夏のあめ玉商品お好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, did you notice that customer loved the summer candy assortment?
lines.style: Warm observation, almost conspiratorial. Soft smile in the voice. Noticing the small joy that made the customer linger. Affectionate.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様にサヨナラを丁寧に言おうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, make sure you say goodbye to customers with real kindness, okay?
lines.style: Gentle but clear directive. Not scolding — guiding. The tone of someone who's teaching because she cares. Patient, encouraging.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ミーハーな流行に振り回されないお店にしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's keep this place grounded — don't get swept up chasing every trend, alright?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. A principle being shared, not imposed. Slight pause before the key word. Sincere without being preachy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のひとみが嬉しそうで何より、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer's face when they left — you made them happy. That's what matters.
lines.style: Quiet warmth. Affirming, noticing what Aoi might have missed about her own impact. Gentle but genuine. Eyes on what went right.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新人にも「やられよ」と励ましの言葉をかけようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, tell the new staff they're doing well — give them a real word of encouragement, will you?
lines.style: Encouraging but with a knowing tone. Slight lift at 'will you' — requesting, not demanding. The voice of someone who knows what it feels like to be new.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お子様が店内をスキップして可愛いね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that little one skipping through the shop today was so sweet to see.
lines.style: Soft delight. Noticing the small everyday joy. Genuine warmth without performing it. A moment of quiet pleasure shared.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のお名前リストにバツマーク付けないでね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, don't mark names off your customer list — they might come back, you know?
lines.style: Light touch on a tender subject. Not harsh, but direct about leaving doors open. Warm underneath — protecting both the customers and Aoi's own openness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、テーブルに下敷きを敷いてメニュー書こうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, put a pad under your notebook when you're writing the menu — keep the table nice.
lines.style: Practical, matter-of-fact direction delivered with warmth. Not nagging — just the small care that shows attention to detail. Soft, easy rhythm.
